description_en: Queries refund/change rules and baggage allowance
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen flight-ota-item-detail --ota-item-id 68cdc6b37c87484c98b479b49306ffbb_0 --isv-name name --order-id 1017060204732105050 --out-order-id 3814233628483219456 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token Dj2laAwE00 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FlightOtaItemDetail

parameters.help_en:
The product ID.

<notice>If querying a rebooking product, pass in the rebooking product otaItemId.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
商品id

<notice>如果查改签商品，请传入改签商品otaItemId></notice>
parameters.name: ota_item_id

parameters.help_en:
The business travel order ID. Either the external order ID or the business travel order ID is required.

<notice>Pass in this parameter when querying refund/change and baggage rules for a rebooking product. The rules may not be calculable for a re-rebooking scenario.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
商旅订单号，外部订单号或商旅订单号二选一必填

<notice>查询改签商品退改行李规则时传入，改后改可能计算不出该规则></notice>
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The external order ID.

<notice>Pass in this parameter when querying refund/change and baggage rules for a rebooking product. The rules may not be calculable for a re-rebooking scenario.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
外部订单号

<notice>查询改签商品退改行李规则时传入，改后改可能计算不出该规则></notice>
parameters.name: out_order_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access credential.

When calling this operation over HTTP, this parameter is required and must be appended to the request URL. For information about how to obtain the credential, see Enterprise Access Credential (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
When appending this parameter, use crop_token=value as a replacement
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，推荐使用 crop_token=value 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
